title: Manosphere / Far-Right Anti-Zionist Cluster on X
question: Which far-right, manosphere, and America First accounts pivoted
scope:
Platform: X public posts with light public-web corroboration. T0 current behavior
  2026-07-27 to 2026-08-26; T1 post-Oct 7 growth 2023-10-01 to 2024-06-30; T2 pre-pivot
  2023-01-01 to 2023-09-30; T3 Detroit AFPAC-replacement node 2024-06-01 to 2024-07-15.
  Languages: English primary; Greek/Danish only if present on Loupis. Geography: US-centric
  manosphere/America First audience plus Danish/Greek Loupis persona. Exclusion: do
  not dump every Free Palestine user; no private contact or family data.
publicInterestBasis: Named accounts in this cluster reach hundreds of thousands
confidence: **Confidence: high on the three pivots and on the schism finding (two independence groups each); medium on channel architecture, lookalike status, and the contestation baseline; low on the Truthteller operator.**

bottomLine.text: **H1 pivots survive re-measurement.** Loupis: backup corpus (160 items to 2026-01) is Israel/Jews-framing dominant; a documented disconfirming corpus query for the old lane (`vaccine OR vax OR pfizer`) returns **2 hits**, both May 2026, one inside a Tate-clip caption. Shields: **0** UFC/MMA hits in 160 T0 items (documented absence). CensoredMen: dormant — most recent retrievable post now **2024-11-16**, and its apparent final post (2024-11-17, cited in the Aug run) **has been deleted** with no Wayback capture.

**The structural finding is a schism, not a cell — and it is now computed, not asserted.** The coordination suite (Pacheco four-stage + Pantè controls, n=4,172 tweets, n_perm=100) returns **5 surviving edges, every one single-trace, every one confidence-capped LOW**. No multi-trace edge exists. The Gage↔Shields/Peters break (JTA press + T0 behavior), Carroll's "not on the same team" (corpus-verified 2026-08-22), the Sneako↔Fuentes fallout item (2026-09-05), and 0-hit queries for Gage→cluster interaction all point the same way.

**H3 holds for brands, and the lookalike picture sharpened.** Loupis = licensed Danish physician (register 0BYZW); Gage rename documented (Wikipedia + API + archive). `@_DrLoupis_` lookalike: dormant since 2023-08-02. **Overturned:** the `@Censored_Men_` clone is **alive** (17 items, last post 2026-08-15) at 429 followers — negligible reach, but not inactive. `@Lucas_Gage_` is resolved as the retired/suspended prior handle of the same account (pid 2432310906; API no data; Wayback profile captures exist, the 2026-07-02 capture renders "Account suspended"; no recoverable content).

**The Kirk lane is an alt-account economy.** @BasedSamParker carries it (45 Kirk corpus mentions, 154 T0 items) with a Candace-adjacent "investigation economy" (`TEXT MESSAGE CHALLENGE @RealCandaceO`, anonymous-contact posts); the main @SamParkerSenate posted **11** T0 items. The factual core of the lane remains refuted — with **corrected provenance**: the Utah charging documents (case 251403576) charge one individual and name no state or foreign actor — a negative-space refutation, not an affirmative judicial finding.

**Community Notes baseline (new, computed):** 201 of 4,200 items (4.8%) carry ≥1 note (529 note↔tweet pairs: 155 direct on harvested posts, 374 second-pass on quoted/retweeted tweets). Direct-note rates on the cluster's own posts: Fuentes **10.5%**, Loupis main 6.2%, Carroll 6.2% vs controls 0–4.2%. **Zero direct notes on the cluster's own posts reached CURRENTLY_RATED_HELPFUL; 22 are NOT_HELPFUL.**

limitations: Two capture layers (API + mirror) + Track B (court record, fact-check corpus, CN corpus, prior-research primaries, archives). All pulls hashed; cache-first; $0.5285 spent by this agent.

**Power notes** are recorded on every medium/negative claim (claims 13, 14, 15, 16, 03): page-capped denominators, control-group baselines, n-too-small cells capped at medium, single-independence-group findings capped.

**Limitations:** (a) 8-page cap = ≥100 items/handle floor met for 19 of 22 handles; 4 handles carry exhaustion notes (Censored_Men_, _DrLoupis_, LucasGageX, Lucas_Gage_) — the zero-item `Lucas_Gage_` passes F03 under validator v1.2 (exhaustion note accepted at count==0) and its F01 resolution is recorded case-side (§14); (b) live-search contradiction pass replaced by corpus queries after budget exhaustion; (c) video captions unverified (no playback); (d) CN snapshot is cumulative to 2026-09-02; (e) synchrony nulls reduced to 2,000 (documented; empirical p floors at 1/2001); (f) convenience sample — descriptive of the sample, not population estimates.
unknowns: **Live contradiction searches** (29 refused at cap): the highest-value reruns are `shields_rahmeh` (is the hoax RT still live?), `truthteller_fee`, `detroit_denials`, and the multilingual Loupis lanes (Greek/Danish) — est. <$0.20 in phase3.
CensoredMen deletion: which post survived and why the 11-17 item was removed (operator scrub vs platform action) — needs a fresh snapshot + archive retry.
Truthtellerftm operator; X-handle vs Truthteller-web-platform ambiguity (registry handoff open).
Whether @DrLoupis main is throttled or strategically quiet (her Musk-row claim, uncorroborated).
Right-of-reply to named persons not sought; publication gate remains uncleared.
Fuentes direct-note rate 10.5% (n=162) — the only cell above the control range; rerun with a fresh CN snapshot to test stability.
contradictions: **Pivot persistence probes:** Loupis vaccine query → 2 residual hits (pivot durable, not total); Shields UFC query → 0 hits (old lane absent).
**Gage split probes:** gage_cluster_ties and shields_gage_reconcile → 0 hits; the severed tie holds.
**Carroll probes:** cluster-boost query → 0 RTs/quotes of principals; counter-reading (highest disputed-content quote rate in corpus, 36 noted items) recorded; capped medium.
**Truthteller probes:** block-fee replication → 0 hits; identity query → nothing; remains single-source, low.
**Main-account probes:** 0 T0 backup-RTs (overturning row); T0 slice = 4 items (power note: n too small to bound a rate).
**Detroit probes:** no denial statements in corpus; Gage-attendance link flagged as the weakest (single advocacy source).
**Kirk factual core:** primary court filing + 3 contradicting fact-checks (AP/CNN/Reuters).

**Budget exhaustion:** the 29 planned live searches were refused by the shared phase2b cap ($1.7028 spent vs $1.50 across three parallel agents) and are recorded as stubs; the pass was executed as documented corpus queries instead. This is a **documented limitation**, not a shortcut: live-search disconfirmation remains open for the claims flagged in §12.
All 17 claims carry ≥2 disconfirming rows in `claim_evidence.csv` (600 evidence rows); queries and results in `data/contradiction_pass.json`. Highlights:
